Hero.title: I build and maintain web applications that
Hero.subtitle: Five years bridging bug fixes, feature development, QA, and support. On the backend, I work across .NET (C#) and NestJS with TypeScript; on the frontend, Next.js and React. Having spent years fixing other people's code, I write mine with the next maintainer in mind.

Profile.title: I started out fixing incidents and ended up writing the code that prevented them.
Profile.text1: That path —IT support, manual QA, full stack development— gave me a concrete way of working: reproduce before touching anything, document every change, and leave the code more readable than I found it. I'm comfortable working in agile teams with Jira and Confluence.
Profile.text2: Today I combine my own product —corporate platforms built and deployed from scratch— with the part that interests me most: delving deeper into web development, best practices and architecture.

bullets: End-to-end development and deployment from scratch of the corporate web platform with WordPress and Elementor.
Custom business logic and functionality through custom code in PHP and JavaScript.
Structuring, responsive design and interface optimization with HTML5 and CSS3.
Integration and synchronization of external management tools, with automated forms in Zoho Forms.
Development of microservices in Catalyst such as payment gateways and notification systems, using Node.js and Express.
Implementation of landing pages in WordPress with Elementor and Divi Builder, optimized for SEO and load speed.
Responsive interfaces to improve the experience across different devices.
Visual optimization with custom CSS and SEO best practices.
Corrective and evolutive maintenance of production applications, on both frontend and backend.
Implementation of new features and resolution of issues reported by support.
Code refactoring to improve performance, readability and maintainability.
Documentation of solutions in Jira and version control with Git.
Design and execution of test plans with Zephyr: regression testing and issue validation.
Direct collaboration with development and support teams, documenting results in Jira.
Handling and resolution of user technical issues, with escalation and follow-up.
Data queries and corrections in Microsoft SQL Server.
